nodes.name: Lemma 4.8
nodes.statement: If $s \twoheadrightarrow t$ has no root-collapsing steps and $s$ reduces to a collapsing redex, then so does $t$.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.7
nodes.statement:
Let $s$ and $t$ be terms with $s \rightarrow t$.
If there is a hypercollapsing reduction starting in $s$, then there is a hypercollapsing reduction starting in $t$.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.5
nodes.statement:
Let $s$ be a term. If there is a hypercollapsing reduction starting from $s$, 
then $s$ is hypercollapsing.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.15: Restricted Strip
nodes.statement: If $S: s \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t$ and $T: s \rightarrow^\mathrm{out} t'$, then $S/T$ and $T/S$ exist and end in the same term.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.14
nodes.statement: Let $s \twoheadrightarrow t$ have $\alpha$ steps that occur outside hypercollapsing subterms. If $s \sim_{hc} s'$, then there exists a reduction $s' \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t'$ of length $\alpha$ such that $t \sim_{hc} t'$. Moreover, for all $\beta \leq \alpha$ the redex pattern and position of the redex contracted in the $\beta$th step of  $s' \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t'$ are identical to those of the $\beta$th step of $s \twoheadrightarrow t$ that occurs outside a hypercollapsing subterm.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.16
nodes.statement: If $s \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t_0$ and $s \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t_1$, then there exist terms $t^*_0$ and $t^*_1$ such that $t_0 \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t^*_0$ and $t_1 \twoheadrightarrow^\mathrm{out} t^*_1$ with $t^*_0 \sim_{hc} t^*_1$.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.17: Confluence modulo $\sim_{hc}$
nodes.statement: Fully-extended, orthogonal iCRSs are confluent modulo $\sim_{hc}$.
